scope: MEM-CLAIM-12 local CPU claim_graph full-function synthetic validation, exact outputs/errors/custom-type fallback; no model KV/QA/TTFT or full Mailbox claims
timing: Frozen plan-v3.json approved before producer; this explicit six-criterion projection records its existing gates for independent verification, not a retroactive protocol change

implementation.procedure: Read source diff/baseline and actual check.py/permanent tests; inspect guards and legacy failure semantics
implementation.acceptance: No hidden output/schema/error/custom-object behavior change; source identity frozen

reference_boundary.procedure: Review producer differentials and graphlib independent cycle oracle; independently exercise size/density/custom types/mixed failures
reference_boundary.acceptance: Exact baseline type/message/output/input identity parity and all independent boundary cases pass

data_integrity.procedure: Recompute canonical input and source/script hashes,21pairs per6workloads, batch counts and input nonmutation; retain all observations
data_integrity.acceptance: No missing/mixed/cherry-picked samples; real baseline file matches pinned main

numerical_sanity.procedure: Recompute medians/percent changes from finite raw ms; Pythonpeak bytes reported separately
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Report calculations agree; units and exclusions explicit

measurement_validity.procedure: Inspect all call boundaries,3warmup batches,21alternating pairs, full function/batches and no concurrent benchmarks; inspect independent replay
measurement_validity.acceptance: 512chain >=25% median reduction; each shared256/small8/empty/star512/dense256 median regression <=15%, for producer AND independent; no allocator/VRAM claims from tracemalloc

reproducibility.procedure: Independent PYTHONHASHSEED=12 replay of check.py --out independent.json, plus supplemental tests
reproducibility.acceptance: Frozen gates and semantic checks pass in both actors; actual environment, limitations and negatives retained
